# Frappes Culture

> Chiplun's famous coffee, shake and juice center — premium cold coffee, frappes, thick milkshakes and mojitos. Scan, browse the menu, order at the counter.

Frappes Culture is a café in Chiplun, Maharashtra serving cold coffee, frappes, shakes and mojitos. The site is a mobile-first digital menu that opens when customers scan the QR code on their table.

## Pages

- [Menu](/): Full digital menu with shakes, frappes, mojitos and FAQs.

## Optional

- [Instagram](https://instagram.com/frappesculture): Latest drinks and updates.
